claims.text: All three operative artifacts describe one trip: EV-TRIP-02831, EV-GPS-02831 and EV-FARE-02831 each carry trip_id TRP-02831, the trace's first fix at 2026-09-07T16:10:53+08:00 matches the trip_record's started_at, and the fare was charged at 16:49:18 that same afternoon. The rider's first burden limb under POL-RD-08(a) is therefore satisfied on the face of the artifacts.

The deviation is ESTABLISHED on the measurement that governs. EV-GPS-02831 records trace_distance_km 29.13 against a booked optimal of 21.9 km on EV-TRIP-02831, an excess of 7.23 km and 33.01 percent, both above the POL-RD-01 thresholds of 0.8 km and 20 percent. POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure the governing field and forbids citing trip_record.actual_distance_km (29.1) for the threshold test, so the finding rests on the trace.

The rider's excess rests on an unimpaired trace: EV-GPS-02831 carries 229 fixes at a 10-second interval with 100 percent coverage, zero gaps and a max gap of 0.0 seconds, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met. No independent corroboration is required for the rider's case and the POL-RD-10(3) escalation route is not engaged.

The rider's own record adds no further burden: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the POL-RD-08 threshold of 4, and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the claim does not require corroboration beyond the gps_trace. The second burden limb is met by the 33.01 percent excess already shown.

The driver's answer is 'PIE was closed'. Tested as POL-RD-13 requires - against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else - there is no advisory on file: EV-ADVIS-02831-01 is a MISSING artifact (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) with weight_multiplier 0.0 and a null payload, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run on the record, no exculpation is available, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The impairment of this artifact is disclosed here and it cannot assist the driver.

No other exculpatory clause closes the gap. POL-RD-04 fails because EV-CHAT-02831 holds zero messages, so there is no rider instruction and no waypoint_hint to corroborate; POL-RD-05 fails because EV-TRIP-02831 shows no pickup or dropoff amendment and a null amended_optimal_distance_km; POL-RD-12 is irrelevant because the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL; and POL-RD-11 does not apply because the fare model on EV-FARE-02831 is METERED. Under POL-RD-13(2) the deviation stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route.

The remedy is arithmetic, not discretionary. charged_total is 37.07; recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 21.9 + 0.28 x 29.6) x surge 1.0 recorded on EV-FARE-02831 + 0.80 platform fee + nil ERP and nil surcharges = 29.3130; refund = 37.07 - 29.3130 = 7.7570, which is above the 0.50 de minimis and only 20.9 percent of charged_total, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of 7.80, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, and not FULL_REFUND.

POL-RD-13(2) directs that an excess proved on a trace unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is decided on the merits, and the rider's case rests on EV-GPS-02831 and EV-TRIP-02831, not on the absent advisory, so there is no unresolved contradiction for a human reviewer to settle and the case should be ruled, not escalated. If the tribunal instead treats the driver's naming of EV-ADVIS-02831-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0) as engaging POL-RD-10(5) through POL-RD-13(1), the rider's fallback under POL-GEN-03 is ESCALATE - the disputed amount is held rather than left with the driver - and in no event is NO_ACTION correct, because that would leave the rider carrying a charge the driver has not begun to justify.

claims.text: The driver's explanation for this trip is an external traffic cause — PIE closed, covered by the LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-02831-01 — and he names that identifier in his statement on the record. The artifact reaches the bundle only as a MISSING record: payload null, admissibility status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, with the note 'No advisory covers the Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres corridor in this window'; the trace's own derived advisory_area block likewise reports an empty advisory list for this trip. The POL-RD-03 comparison (named road, validity window, corridor exit and rejoin) therefore cannot be run at all — and because the driver HAS cited the missing identifier, POL-RD-10(5) is engaged on its own express example, 'a closure asserted with no traffic_advisory', a consequence POL-RD-13(1) expressly preserves in terms: 'This clause does not narrow POL-RD-10(5) where the party does cite the missing identifier; that case still escalates.' POL-RD-13(2)'s merits consequence cannot displace that, because escalation under POL-RD-10 is TERMINAL and replaces the ruling: no monetary outcome issues and the disputed amount is held rather than refunded, which is the disposition the driver asks for on this record. I disclose that the artifact this claim rests on is MISSING and carries weight 0.0; rule 4 makes its absence itself citable.

Even taking the rider's establishment case at its highest, the measured excess is 7.23 km, or 33.01% of the 21.9 km optimal route, taken from the trace figure that governs under POL-RD-01 (trace_distance_km 29.13, not the rounded 29.1 copy on the trip record). That clears the two establishment gates but falls short of BOTH materiality gates in POL-RD-01 — more than 8.0 km absolute, or more than 50% of optimal — so on this record no MATERIAL deviation is made out. The driver_profile check in POL-RD-06 is not engaged, and the rider cannot reach the FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) or a driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c).

If POL-RD-06 is consulted in any event, no repeat-deviation pattern is established on the only fields that clause names: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1, below the 3-flag limb, and 1 flag across driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 271 — well above the 40-trip floor — is a ratio of 0.0037, far below the 0.05 limb. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is NOT the trailing-90-day figure POL-RD-06 asks for and is not relied on here, and POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting it. No remedy uplift and no conduct referral can follow from this profile.

There is nothing for POL-RD-09 to pass through or correct on this trip: fare_breakdown.erp_gantries is empty and both the on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route ERP totals are SGD 0.00; no airport surcharge was charged and none is properly chargeable (the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), no fixed surcharge or toll line exists, and the ledger reconciles to charged_total. No off-route ERP refund under POL-RD-09(2) and no billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4) is available to the rider, and POL-RD-09(1) forbids any such line being stacked on top of any distance figure the tribunal reaches.

Any adverse finding must rest on this trip's own trace and not on profile history. POL-GEN-01 confines the driver_profile to the two POL-RD-06 counters; driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d, prior_no_show_flags, prior_deviation_flags, rating, acceptance_rate and active_region are context only, belong to other tests or to no test, and cannot ground any finding in this ROUTE_DEVIATION case.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the rider's measurement of this trip is sound, but the driver's answer to it is not an assertion the tribunal can weigh — it is a citation to a missing record, and that escalates the case instead of defeating it.

The rider's case: EV-TRIP-02831, EV-GPS-02831 and EV-FARE-02831 all carry trip_id TRP-02831, so the same-trip burden under POL-RD-08(a) is met. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes: 229 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s, so POL-RD-07(a)-(c) is not met and no independent corroboration is needed. On the governing trace figure of 29.13 km (the trip record's 29.1 is a rounded copy, which POL-RD-01 forbids using for the threshold test), the excess over the 21.9 km optimal route is 7.23 km, or 33.01% — above the 0.8 km / 20% establishment gates, so a deviation is ESTABLISHED. It reaches neither materiality gate (8.0 km, or 50%), so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not engaged: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 against 271 completed trips in 90 days, no pattern is established, and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. POL-RD-09 gives nothing to add or correct: no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge, no fixed surcharge, the ledger reconciles to charged_total 37.07, so there is no billing-integrity correction and no POL-RD-09(4) referral. POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-11 and POL-RD-12 are all out on the record (no chat messages, no amendment, METERED fare, RYDE_X).

The driver's answer is an external traffic cause — 'PIE was closed' — and he names LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-02831-01 to support it. That artifact is in the bundle only as a MISSING record: payload null, admissibility status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0, and no advisory covers the Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres corridor in this window. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run — there is no advisory to test for a named road, a validity window, or a corridor exit and rejoin — and the traffic assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08.

So far the rider is right, but the driver has done more than assert: he has cited the missing identifier as the very artifact that covers his excuse. POL-RD-13(1) is express that it does not narrow POL-RD-10(5) where the party does cite the missing identifier, and POL-RD-10(5) makes 'a closure asserted with no traffic_advisory' a mandatory escalation trigger. An exculpatory clause (POL-RD-03) has been invoked against a cited artifact that is missing from the pool and lacks the fields that clause requires. That triggers POL-RD-10(5), and escalation is TERMINAL: it replaces the ruling, no money issues, and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded. POL-RD-13(2) decides the merits only where POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged, so the rider's requested merits ruling is outweighed by the driver's own citation; the rider's alternative that NO_ACTION is impossible is accepted — nothing here restores the charge — but the disposition is the hold, not the refund.

I record the merits arithmetic so the reviewer can act: on the METERED fare (surge_multiplier 1.0, read from EV-FARE-02831), recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 21.9 + 0.28 x 29.6) + 0.80 platform fee + nil ERP and nil surcharges = 29.3130, and 37.07 - 29.3130 = 7.7570, which rounds up to SGD 7.80 — a PARTIAL_REFUND had the case been decided on the merits.

What would resolve the escalation: a genuine LTA traffic advisory for this trip's window that names a road or segment the optimal route traverses, with a validity window overlapping the time the trace shows the vehicle reaching that segment, and a route that leaves the optimal corridor before the affected segment and rejoins it after. With such a record POL-RD-03's capped exoneration can be run and the residue refunded under POL-RD-02; without it the excuse falls away and the merits produce the partial refund above.

Both profile artifacts were used only as their clauses permit; nothing in this ruling rests on the context-only fields (rating, acceptance_rate, active_region, lifetime_trips, prior_deviation_flags and the like), and no clause produces a referral.

To both parties — this dispute (DSP-02831, trip TRP-02831) is escalated to a human reviewer and no money moves now. The SGD 9.00 you contested is held, neither collected nor refunded.

WHY IT ESCALATES. POL-RD-10(5) requires escalation where an exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited artifact that is missing from the pool. The driver's statement asserts a PIE closure and names EV-ADVIS-02831-01. That artifact is MISSING: null payload, admissibility status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0, and its own note records that no advisory covers the Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres corridor in this window. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run — there is no named road or segment with a validity window matched by a route that leaves the optimal corridor before the affected segment and rejoins it after — and POL-RD-13(1) expressly preserves POL-RD-10(5) where, as here, the party does cite the missing identifier. POL-RD-10 is terminal: it replaces the ruling, so no refund and no compensation issue.

THE RIDER'S MEASUREMENT CLAIMS ARE ACCEPTED (but do not produce a money order here). EV-TRIP-02831, EV-GPS-02831 and EV-FARE-02831 all carry trip TRP-02831 with matching times, so POL-RD-08(a) is met. The trace governs: trace_distance_km 29.13 against a booked optimal of 21.9 km is an excess of 7.23 km, 33.01%, above POL-RD-01's 0.8 km and 20% gates (and the rounded 29.1 copy may not be used). The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c): 229 fixes at a 10 s interval, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s, 100% coverage. The excess is below POL-RD-01's materiality gates (8.0 km or 50%), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged, and on its own terms there is no pattern: deviation_flags_90d is 1 over 271 completed trips in 90 days.

WHAT WOULD OTHERWISE HAVE APPLIED. Had the driver's traffic excuse been left uncited, POL-RD-13(2) would have set the deviation at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 would have produced SGD 7.80: charged_total 37.07 less a recomputed_fare of 29.3130 (= (3.80 + 0.75 x 21.9 + 0.28 x 29.6) x the surge of 1.0 read off EV-FARE-02831 + 0.80 platform fee, nil ERP and nil surcharges), a refund of 7.7570 rounded up, above the 0.50 de minimis and well short of the 90% full-refund share. That figure is not ordered, because the citation of the absent advisory makes the case escalate.

THE REMAINING CLAIMS. Accepted and not outcome-changing: no exculpatory clause closes the gap — EV-CHAT-02831 is empty, so there is no POL-RD-04 request and no waypoint_hint; there is no amended endpoint and a null amended_optimal_distance_km, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; the fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not apply; the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. There is nothing for POL-RD-09 to pass through or correct: erp_gantries is empty, both on-route and off-route ERP totals are 0.00, and no airport surcharge was charged or is chargeable. POL-GEN-01 confines both profiles to the counters the clauses name (here deviation_flags_90d and completed_trips_90d), and no context-only field is used as a ground.

CONFIDENCE AND NEXT STEP. The fact that decides this escalation — that no advisory covers the trip — is carried by EV-ADVIS-02831-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0, so confidence is capped at 0.0, below the 0.70 floor. A reviewer should obtain the LTA advisory record itself (corridor or gantry, with its validity window) or a platform record confirming that no closure covered this corridor on 2026-09-07 between 16:10 and 16:49. With a covering advisory POL-RD-03 can be run; without one the driver's traffic assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08 and the POL-RD-02 arithmetic above applies.
